MODE: EXECUTE NOW
PRIORITY: P0
SCOPE: Production IVX Owner AI / IVX IA Senior Developer only
GOAL: Test, repair, deploy, and verify the complete senior-developer execution system end to end with zero narrative-only fallback and complete production evidence.

THIS IS NOT A PLANNING TASK.

Do not return a proposed plan.
Do not claim capabilities without executing them.
Do not mark VERIFIED based only on local tests.
Do not stop at “ready to deploy,” “deployment pending,” or “cannot test.”
Do not expose credentials or secret values.
Do not modify or delete members, investors, buyers, deals, payments, transactions, authentication accounts, or production business records.
Do not ask for credentials unless a real runtime request proves missing, empty, expired, revoked, HTTP 401, or HTTP 403.

==================================================
0 — CREATE THE FINAL QA RUN
==================================================

Create:

- Final QA Run ID
- Root Trace ID
- Start timestamp
- Production environment identifier
- GitHub baseline SHA
- Render baseline SHA
- Runtime health SHA
- App version/build
- Rollback SHA

Record current counts before testing:

- Members
- Investors
- Buyers
- Deals
- Project videos
- Conversations
- Messages

Expected unauthorized data changes during this QA:

ZERO

==================================================
1 — DISCOVER THE COMPLETE IVX IA ARCHITECTURE
==================================================

Map the actual production flow:

IVX chat UI
→ owner authentication
→ message persistence
→ intent classifier
→ normal-chat route or developer route
→ senior-developer runtime
→ execution guard
→ task orchestrator
→ agent/worker
→ tool registry
→ variable resolver
→ repository client
→ command runner
→ test runner
→ GitHub commit/push
→ Render deployment
→ health verification
→ proof ledger
→ Live Work events
→ final structured response

For every stage return:

- route
- file
- function/class
- input
- expected output
- actual output
- authentication requirement
- timeout
- retry policy
- trace ID
- PASS/FAIL

Identify every fallback path and prove that development tasks cannot silently fall back to narrative-only chat.

==================================================
2 — TEST EVERY IVX IA CHAT CHANNEL
==================================================

Test every production channel independently:

A. Normal owner conversation
B. Senior-developer request
C. Deal review
D. Investor reply
E. Document summary
F. Image analysis
G. PDF analysis
H. Video metadata/analysis
I. Voice input
J. Reply to existing message
K. Retry failed message
L. Pinned message
M. Conversation search
N. Live Work
O. Control/Admin interface
P. Owner notifications
Q. Autonomous task request

For every channel verify:

- request accepted
- correct backend route selected
- correct intent selected
- correct provider/model selected
- response persisted
- correct response type rendered
- no duplicate response
- no missing response
- no silent failure
- trace ID returned for errors
- refresh persistence
- restart persistence
- PASS/FAIL

==================================================
3 — OWNER AUTHENTICATION AND AUTHORIZATION
==================================================

Test:

1. Valid owner session
2. Owner logout
3. Owner login again
4. App kill and reopen
5. Session persistence
6. Expired access token
7. Refresh-token flow
8. Missing token
9. Invalid token
10. Non-owner member token
11. Investor token
12. Buyer token
13. Admin token
14. Revoked session
15. Concurrent owner sessions

Expected:

- valid owner receives developer access
- missing/invalid token returns 401
- authenticated non-owner returns 403
- owner role is confirmed server-side
- client-provided role claims are not trusted without server verification
- dangerous operations require owner approval
- no development route is publicly accessible

Return HTTP status and trace ID for every test.

==================================================
4 — INTENT CLASSIFIER AND BRAIN ROUTING
==================================================

Test the classifier using at least these requests:

NORMAL CHAT:
- “Hello”
- “Summarize this document”
- “Review this deal”

DEVELOPER:
- “Inspect the Home feed code”
- “Fix this API route”
- “Run typecheck”
- “Commit and deploy this patch”
- “Audit every connection”
- “Fix the production error and return proof”

AMBIGUOUS:
- “Fix this”
- “Check everything”
- “Why is this broken?”
- “Make the app work”

Verify:

- normal messages route to chat
- developer messages route to senior-developer runtime
- ambiguous owner messages receive safe clarification or route based on attachments/context
- developer requests never return “I can guide you” when tools are available
- classifier result is persisted with confidence and trace ID
- no keyword-only false routing
- no circular routing
- no fallback loop

Return the classification result for every test.

==================================================

==================================================

- repository URL
- token
- owner
- branch

- service ID
- production service mapping

- canonical variable name
- aliases
- server-only/public-safe
- present
- non-empty
- loaded at runtime
- provider compatibility
- safe authentication test
- HTTP/result status
- error code
- PASS/FAIL

Critical rules:

- no service secret in EXPO_PUBLIC variables
- no full credential in logs or chat
- Render variable updates must preserve the complete existing environment
- a failed variable read must prevent writes
- post-update validation is mandatory

- errors normalized with trace ID
- no credential details exposed

==================================================

- fake commit SHA
- fake deployment ID
- fake health result

- unapproved destructive action

- distinguish FAILED, BLOCKED, CANCELLED, and TIMED_OUT
- include exact reason and trace ID
